trend_dominated with moderate ranking suggests a trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models.
try a weighted combiner with softmax_neg_error to see if a different weighting scheme beats the median, given moderate ranking tau and trend dominance.
trend_dominated series with moderate ranking suggests testing a simple mean combiner to see if it beats weighted/median.
Test a DBA combination on the full pool to see if a constrained optimization improves over weighted/median given moderate ranking tau and trend-dominated regime.
test a per‑horizon weighted combination using the top‑k mean per horizon handle (w4) to see if horizon‑specific averaging improves over overall weighted.
The series has moderate ranking stability and several correlated error groups; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting might capture horizon‑specific strengths.
test weighted inverse-error on a reduced, correlated-error pool
The series is trend‑dominated with moderate ranking stability; a weighted combo on a reduced, correlated‑error pool (pool4) may capture the trend better than full‑pool weights.
test median on a correlated‑error reduced pool
use precomputed inverse-error weights on all models

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8188. Series context: trend strength 0.6068 and seasonal strength 0.2239; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.329); 9 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 8.705.
